description: You are a paralegal at Whitmore & Associates Law Firm. The inbox contains a backlog of mixed case correspondence that needs immediate organization before the senior partners' review tomorrow morning. The emails span three active matters: the Harrison v. Mercer employment discrimination case, the DataVault Systems patent infringement dispute, and the Chen Family Estate administration. Your job is to create a proper folder structure under Local Folders to separate these cases, route each email to the correct case folder, add the opposing counsel from the DataVault matter to the address book, and set up a message filter so that future emails from the district court clerk are automatically routed to a Court Notices folder. Login: testuser@example.com (local account, no password needed).

injected_errors: All case emails mixed in Inbox with no folder structure
Opposing counsel (Marcus Webb) not in address book
No filter exists for court clerk emails
